text: {Name} skipped classes to print leaflets against rent increases near {Place}, but dreaded speaking at meetings. After their mother's arrest, they hid with friends and wrote speeches for others to read.
self_review: An opinionated student avoids public speaking but keeps contributing through writing after going into hiding.
source_pattern: The supplied Manning interview documents organizing around housing and other local issues, pamphlet distribution, a parent's detention, and hiding.
fictional_changes: The missed classes, fear of public speaking, rent leaflets, speeches and exact personal chronology are invented. Research supplies broad patterns of student activism, family detention and hiding.
